<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Default">5e5a4b46833eb210979271d6feaad3f8</macroponent><name>Validate Login</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[(function(api){
    var username = api.state.username;
    var password = api.state.password;

    var ga = new GlideAjax('StudentLogin');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name','validateLogin');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_username', username);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_password', password);

    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response){

            api.navigation.navigate('/student-dashboard');
        } else {
            alert("Invalid Username or Password");
        }
    });
